name: Haitoku Shitei Soukan ~Ane no Midara na Yawaniku~
original_name: 背徳姉弟相姦～姉の淫らな柔肉～
source:
Ryota feels sorry for her older sister, Misa. Since their parents died she brought him up by herself. One day, she says to him that she is going to marry a man of wealthy family. Ryota thinks she will marry that man for Ryota entering university. He realizes that she is more than just a sister for him.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090305064750/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003083]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
亮太为她的姐姐美沙感到难过。自从父母去世后，她就独自抚养他长大。有一天，她对他说，她要嫁给一个有钱人家的男人。凉太认为她会为了让凉太进入大学而嫁给那个男人。他意识到她对他来说不仅仅是一个妹妹。

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090305064750/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1003083]ErogeShop[/url]]
